page.overview:
Who is Moon Isaac Jr.?

Moon Isaac Jr. is a member of the former Roger Pirates and their until the crew's dissolution. His current whereabouts and status are unknown.

Isaac has a long, beak-like nose, slicked back short brown hair, and a dark moustache. He has a rotund body shape and wears a tan shirt, a golden cape, striped trousers, and long black boots, while holding a rapier.

He seems to be weak to compliments as he became flustered when Roger spoke highly of the crew.

Isaac held the status of tactical staff officer within the Roger Pirates, implying a higher rank among the crew. As a tactician, he likely had expertise in devising battle strategies.
